ceo-2026.name: CEO 2026
ceo-2026.description:
As one of the most iconic spectacles in fighting games, CEO 2026 brings its signature professional wrestling aesthetic back to Orlando with high-stakes Street Fighter 6 action at the center. Founded in 2010, the tournament built its reputation around its famous ring stage and championship belt trophies, growing into a cornerstone summer major after hosting over 6,000 attendees in 2025. Global visibility makes the weekend a critical proving ground on the annual calendar, drawing international contenders to compete in front of an energetic crowd.

The event holds official Capcom Pro Tour Premier status, raising the stakes dramatically for the Street Fighter 6 bracket. The tournament champion secures direct qualification for Capcom Cup, while top finishers earn essential CPT ranking points toward global leaderboard standings. Victory inside the ring provides both immediate qualification leverage and one of the most prestigious titles in the community.

Convention Floor and Tournament Lineup

Beyond the primary championship, the event hosts bracket competition across major titles including Tekken 8, Guilty Gear -Strive-, and Mortal Kombat 1. Attendees can explore a broad exhibitor floor featuring fightstick vendors, artist alley displays, and dedicated arcade spaces running classic titles throughout the weekend. Registration is managed through start.gg, with badge pickup operating on-site before official pool play begins.

umad-2026.name: UMAD 2026
umad-2026.location: 550 Rue Richmond, Montréal, QC H3J 1V3, Canada
umad-2026.description:
UMAD 2026 (Ultimate Montreal Airdashers) returns for another edition, bringing together the fighting game community for a multi-day celebration of competitive play across a wide lineup of titles, with Street Fighter 6 among the featured games.

Organized by the Montreal Airdashers, the event is known for its passionate community atmosphere. Registration and the latest information are available on the official Start.gg event page.

Registration and the latest information are available on the official Start.gg event page.
